description:
Run Guild.ai agents from a RocketRide pipeline or an agent.
As a pipeline step, lane input is sent to a configured Guild agent as a session and its answer flows downstream; as a tool, an agent can start Guild sessions and inspect their status and transcript.
Guild is the control plane for AI agents — RocketRide prepares the data, a governed Guild agent performs the action.

agent.description: Agent to run as the pipeline step, and the default for the run_agent tool. Required for the pipeline step; an agent may override it per call.
agent.title: Agent

apiKeyId.description: The id half of a Guild trigger API key. Guild authenticates with HTTP Basic — the key id is the username. Create a key on the trigger's page in the Guild app.
apiKeyId.title: API Key ID

apiKeySecret.description: The secret half of the Guild trigger API key (the Basic auth password). Shown once when the key is created.
apiKeySecret.title: API Key Secret

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the Guild API. Leave as the default for Guild Cloud; override only for an enterprise or self-hosted deployment.
baseUrl.title: Guild Base URL

maxSessions.description: Cap on Guild sessions this node may start in one pipeline run. Guild bills per automation (the free tier allows 100/month), so this bounds a runaway agent loop.
maxSessions.title: Max sessions per run

owner.description: The owner name that the workspace lives under, as it appears in the Guild app URL (app.guild.ai/<owner>/<workspace>).
owner.title: Workspace owner

resultMode.description: Guild runs agents asynchronously; 'wait' polls the session until it finishes. 'start' returns the session id without waiting — useful for fire-and-forget tool calls, but the pipeline step always waits (a session id is of no use downstream).
resultMode.title: Result mode

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for a session to finish before raising. Guild's own turn timeout is 3600s; a timeout here does NOT cancel the session on Guild's side — the session id is reported so the run stays traceable.
timeout.title: Session timeout (seconds)

verifyTls.description: Leave ON. Disable only for a self-hosted Guild served with a self-signed certificate.
verifyTls.title: Verify TLS certificate

workspace.description: The Guild workspace holding the agent to run, as it appears in the app URL.
workspace.title: Workspace

ui:enumNames: Start the session and return immediately

title: Guild.ai
